name: Suzuki Savage / Boulevard S40
engine: 652 cc air-cooled SOHC single, one carb, belt drive
intro: A simple big-single cruiser. Keep up with valve adjustments, the carb and the belt.

H: The valves need regular adjustment. Don't skip it.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Valve adjustments
known.what: Older bikes wear on valve adjustments and the clutch. Brakes are a common complaint.
